description: This file defines a custom exception class `GroupHasNoStaffException` used in the Apache Fineract project, specifically within the group portfolio module. It extends a platform-specific exception to signal that a group in the system has no associated staff.

classes.name: GroupHasNoStaffException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a group resource has no associated staff, used for error handling within the system.

methods.name: GroupHasNoStaffException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code and message indicating the group ID that has no staff.
